scope: Every substantive legacy claim or claim group is covered below. Ranges refer to the original commit, not generated files. HTML/CSS presentation-only lines do not require external fact verification. “Not inspected” is not a finding that a source is false.

entries.subject: Reverse-engineered system description
entries.review: Public-description research is not a recovered projection system.

entries.subject: Clean-room / operator / universal verification
entries.review: Retain BetFully developer attribution; remove unverified LLC corporate history and any guarantee that every prior claim was verified.

entries.subject: 13 sports and 100+ factors
entries.review: 13 observed menu labels; 100+ variables is a vendor claim, not independently validated feature engineering.

entries.subject: Monthly price
entries.review: Displayed web offer; not a checkout quote.

entries.subject: Paid main tools, consensus, Props AI, Best Ball
entries.review: Projection/consensus premium inclusion supported. Do not assume exact access for every tool or MLB Best Ball scope/date.

entries.subject: NFL / NCAAF / CFL report scope
entries.review: Document only observed NFL menu tools; no unsupported cross-league inheritance.

entries.subject: NBA / WNBA / NCAAB usage matrix scope
entries.review: NBA guide supports usage scenarios; no extension to other basketball leagues.

entries.subject: MLB Dingers / matchups
entries.review: A pricing-page feature label and a guide support these descriptions, not their predictive quality.

entries.subject: Projected ownership
entries.review: Describe target estimate and documented inputs, not demonstrated GPP advantage.

entries.subject: Perfect lineups for backtesting
entries.review: Hindsight optimal outcome is an upper bound, not a predictive strategy backtest. Free historical view advertised.

entries.subject: Salary comparison / changes
entries.review: Public navigation only; exact output and access not tested.

entries.subject: Confirmed lineups, live scoring and update reasons
entries.review: Retain menu descriptions; remove unsupported latency and precise-trigger guarantees.

entries.subject: News, articles, community chat / FanSense
entries.review: Chat and crowd sentiment are distinct features; no unsupported detailed feed taxonomy.

entries.subject: 150+ lineups and three platforms
entries.review: Neither performance nor current contest coverage tested.

entries.subject: Stacking, bring-backs, exact groups, exposure caps
entries.review: Stacking and exposures supported broadly. Exact group cardinalities, bring-back and per-position cap controls not verified.

entries.subject: Late swap
entries.review: Separate individual replacement from bulk Swaptimize; entries must be updated at operator.

entries.subject: CSV and automatic column detection
entries.review: Export supported; import guide requires column and outlier-name mapping, not guaranteed auto-detection.

entries.subject: Sports covered list
entries.review: Observed labels only. Do not infer current activity, all-tool availability, or CS2 mapping.

entries.subject: Every detailed input explicitly documented
entries.review: Separate vendor-described input categories from our own proposed features and candidate sources.

entries.subject: Detailed history / matchup inputs
entries.review: Only broad documented categories attributed to vendor. Additional rates and splits are design proposals.

entries.subject: Sports Reference and clients as free alternatives
entries.review: Maintainer software is not a league-operated API or a blanket data license.

entries.subject: Statcast / NBA clients
entries.review: Official Statcast field definitions and NBA glossary linked; client/data rights separated.

entries.subject: Odds and ESPN endpoints as free source
entries.review: No unsupported ESPN endpoint contract. The Odds API requires an API key; entitlements unverified.

entries.subject: Weather inputs / free access
entries.review: Weather category supported. NWS documented; Open-Meteo hosted free access is non-commercial only.

entries.subject: Injury and starting-lineup feeds
entries.review: No claim that depth charts / rosters provide confirmed starters or that all league APIs exist.

entries.subject: Salary scraping recommendation
entries.review: No operator lobby scraper or automated protected access; require authorized feed.

entries.subject: Ownership model inputs / labels
entries.review: Keep only documented input categories. No assumed social or public-winner training dataset.

entries.subject: News / sentiment feeds
entries.review: Beat/team sources described; specific tweet, locker-room and NLP claims not established.

entries.subject: Consensus providers and free picks
entries.review: Weighted average documented; constituent providers/weights and reuse rights unknown.

entries.subject: Publicly stated algorithm
entries.review: No full reproducible algorithm obtained; distinguish marketing description from project design.

entries.subject: Base statistical model
entries.review: History/recent form/matchups described, not model parameters.

entries.subject: 100 modifiers and real-time reruns
entries.review: Count is a vendor claim; documented changing conditions and human review added. No latency measured.

entries.subject: Consensus reduces model risk
entries.review: Document averaging; no independently measured bias / error reduction.

entries.subject: Vendor uses integer / knapsack optimization
entries.review: Optimization is a generic project choice. Vendor implementation was not established.

entries.subject: Patents / titles / core claims / continuation
entries.review: Keep only vendor-listed patent numbers. Remove unverified titles, lineage and claim-scope paraphrases; link USPTO review route.

entries.subject: Standard algorithms generally non-infringing
entries.review: Independent implementation and standard methods do not establish freedom to operate; counsel required.

entries.subject: Universal premium price and inclusions
entries.review: Separate web vs US app price, dated offer vs checkout, inclusion vs exclusive paid access.

entries.subject: List of no-free-public-access components
entries.review: Per-feature access status; Perfect Lineups advertises free historical access. Many exact boundaries remain unknown.

entries.subject: Only public / licensed sources
entries.review: No rights manifest existed. Proposed candidates are not approved licensed integrations.

entries.subject: Automatic data-pipeline plan
entries.review: No unsupported scraper APIs, lobby scraping or unapproved news feeds. Add license, timestamp, freshness and identity gates.

entries.subject: Model / consensus scraping / self-healing retraining
entries.review: Keep baseline proposal; no competitive-output harvesting. Vendor self-healing text does not establish nightly auto-retraining.

entries.subject: Ownership training from posted winners
entries.review: Need licensed contest-wide labels with known population; selection-biased posts are not established training truth.

entries.subject: MILP plan, GPP score and unfinished-game swap
entries.review: Implementation is bounded independent search. Remove unvalidated leverage objective. Freeze started-game players in exact slots, not just finished games.

entries.subject: Web stack, free hosting and data branch
entries.review: Pages static site works now. Future sports backend/secret storage not delivered; no other branch is used.

entries.subject: Prop mean gap as +EV
entries.review: Probability and payout arithmetic separated from projection gaps. Calibration remains missing.

entries.subject: Legal / TOS flag
entries.review: Explicit restriction evidence; no user-upload requirement substituted for authorization.

entries.subject: Patents and unknown coefficients
entries.review: Unknowns preserved without implying patent safety or recovered factors.

entries.subject: Guessed suppliers / minutes-behind guarantee
entries.review: No LineStar supplier identities or comparative latency measured.

entries.subject: Ownership timing and no free bulk API exists
entries.review: This project has not secured licensed ownership labels; no exhaustive claim about all available sources.

entries.subject: News sentiment adds real edge
entries.review: Reporting categories are documented; predictive NLP benefit is not established.

entries.subject: Lower accuracy for minor sports / mandatory paid props
entries.review: Coverage and quality are unmeasured; quote/account-level access review required, not blanket claims.

entries.subject: Mobile outside first build
entries.review: Responsive site is delivered; no native mobile app or notifications.

entries.subject: All official / every claim verified / all accessed
entries.review: Source records specify publisher class, observation method, date, excerpt and limits. Some old links were not inspected.

entries.subject: Vendor sources 1–7
entries.review: Retain observed homepage/pricing/GitBook and one inspected US App Store listing. Uninspected FD/Google Play entries are not promoted as verified.

entries.subject: Google Patents sources 8–11
entries.review: No Google Patents mirror asserted to be the official legal record; vendor patent numbers plus verified USPTO search route.

entries.subject: Projection / ownership pages 12–13
entries.review: Documentation supports descriptions. No paid output access or live endpoint validation was performed.

entries.subject: Alternative source links 14–23
entries.review: nflverse and nba_api maintainers inspected. Unreviewed pybaseball, nhl-api-py, sportsipy, BALLDONTLIE, TheSportsDB and ESPN gist are not certified or used. OR-Tools is not a runtime dependency. Official / maintainer source records replace a blanket free-data list.

entries.subject: Disclaimer / generation date
entries.review: Explicit independent project, dated research snapshot and synthetic demo disclaimer; no affiliation claim.

entries.subject: Title and promised full verified list
entries.review: README now states exact shipped scope and uncertainty; no full private-system recovery or quality guarantee.

entries.subject: Project structure
entries.review: Document source data, shared engine, deterministic generation, tests, browser demo, CI and root publishing fallback.

entries.subject: Verified official source blanket
entries.review: Separate vendor, league, government, platform and community-maintainer documentation; no automatic semantic-proof claim.

entries.subject: Educational / legal disclaimer
entries.review: No bypass, protected-output ingestion, legal safety, or investment/performance guarantees.
